Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:89126
Court No. - 73
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 17315 of 2024

Applicant :- Deenanath Nishad And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Jitendra Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

1. Heard Sri Jitendra Singh, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Imran Khan learned Aga for
the State-respondent.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicants on bail in Case Crime No.
333 of 2023, under Sections 3 (1) U.P. Gangsters Act, Police Station Raunapar, District Azamgarh,
during pendency of the trial in the court below.
3. Applicants were made accused in the present case on the basis of solitary case shown against them in the gang chart.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that applicants are neither member nor leader of any gang and they never indulged in any anti-social activity.

5. He further submitted that the solitary case shown in the gang chart is of section 376 D IPC and SC/ST Act but the victim of the case during trial did not support the prosecution and has been Deenanath Nishad And Another vs State Of U.P. on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163613167/
1 declared hostile and after considering this fact, in that case applicants were enlarged on bail vide orders dated 13.3.2024 passed in Crl. Misc. Bail Application Nos. 1657 of 2024 and 1631 of 2024 and bail orders passed by this Court are annexed as annexure-3 to the affidavit.
6.

sentences.text:
He further submitted that apart from the present case and solitary case shown in the gang chart,
applicants are not having any previous criminal history to their credit and in the present matter,
they are in jail since 16.10.2023 i.e. for last more than six months.
7.
Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the factual arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicants.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. From the perusal of the record, it appears that however, on the basis of solitary case of gang rape shown in the gang chart, applicants were made accused in the present case but it appears, in that case, after considering entire facts of the case, this Court enlarged them on bail.
10.

Further, apart from the present case and the solitary case shown in the gang chart, applicants are not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter, they are in jail since 16.10.2023 i.e. for last more than six months.

11. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicants are entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicants-Deenanath Nishad and Vinay Nishad, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicants shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless their personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicants shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicants shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicants.
